requirements.evidence: All main requirements are present: migration with unique(entity_id,email) and cascade FKs (database/migrations/2026_10_29_032306_create_entity_invites_table.php:12-31), model normalization (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:40-43), pending scope (:60), sendInvite with duplicate/pending/rate-limit/race handling (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:48-127), PendingInvites accept/decline with 403 and expiry error (app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:16-73), queued markdown mail with login link and pt_BR strings (app/Mail/EntityInviteMail.php:26-39, resources/views/emails/entity-invite.blade.php:1-17), manager-only page/modals (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:89-146), switcher/onboarding placement (resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:8, resources/views/livewire/entity/create-entity.blade.php:18), route guard (routes/web.php:56) and lang keys (lang/en/ui.php, lang/pt_BR/ui.php). Remaining gaps: pt_BR subject, accepted-invite deletion, entities soft-deleted after an invite.

conventions.evidence: Good: #[Validate] on public inputs and $this->validate()/validateOnly() (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:29-38, 56-62, 162), policy authorization (Members.php:44, 50, 131, 146, 160; PendingInvites.php:21, 63), generated-style migration with reversible down() (migration:12-33), docs and CHANGELOG updated (docs/business-rules.md:75, docs/database-schema.md:148-160, CHANGELOG.md). Deviations: record ID/flag properties are not #[Locked] (Members.php:35, 40) and domain writes are done inline in the Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* (PendingInvites.php:35; Members.php:95-108).

security.evidence: Every impactful action authorizes server-side and re-resolves the record against the current entity: sendInvite/cancelInvite/openMember/saveRole (Members.php:50, 131, 146, 160), accept/decline via invitee e-mail match (PendingInvites.php:21, 63, 100-105); records are looked up with $this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail() (Members.php:245) so foreign IDs cannot be reached. All public inputs are validated, Blade uses {{ }} escaping, and EntityInvite declares #[Fillable]. Gaps of limited impact: confirmRemoval()/cancelRemoval() perform no authorize() (Members.php:188-196) and selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval are client-writable without #[Locked] (Members.php:35, 40).

tests.evidence: Broad Pest coverage exists: tests/Feature/Entity/EntityInviteTest.php:17-120 (schema, normalization, casts, mail en/pt_BR, queued mail), tests/Feature/Entity/PendingInvitesTest.php:13-171 (listing, accept, 403, expiry, idempotency, no duplicate membership, decline, onboarding hr) and tests/Feature/Entity/MembersTest.php:160-300 (invite, validation, duplicate, rate limit, error-once, cancel, modals, role save, confirmation). However the tests 'cannot remove the last manager of an entity' and 'cannot remove the owner; managers can remove members' are deleted in this diff and the new removal test (MembersTest.php:250-266) only removes an employee, so removeMember()'s never-owner/never-last-manager rules are now untested; there is also no tamper test on selectedMembershipId.

simplicity.evidence: Lean and mostly reusing existing pieces: existing x-mail::message theme and ui lang maps, one sendInvite() method for the whole flow, small helpers (Members.php:241-259). Some speculative leftovers: invitedBy(), scopeExpired(), isPending() and the accepted() factory state are unused by production code (app/Models/EntityInvite.php:52, 65, 70; database/factories/EntityInviteFactory.php:39), and e-mail normalization is duplicated in the component and the model (Members.php:59, EntityInvite.php:40-43).

readability.evidence: Clear names and focused protected helpers (selectedMembership, inviteRateLimitKey, isInviteConflict, Members.php:241-259); views use translated labels consistently (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:2-7, 89, 130). Minor: sendInvite spans ~70 lines mixing validation, lookups, rate limiting, transaction, mail and audit (Members.php:48-127), and isInviteConflict reasons over exception text (:251-259).

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: invite migration/model/factory/mail, Members and PendingInvites components, their Blade views, lang files, route guard, docs/CHANGELOG and tests. The nav/dashboard edits only hide the members link from non-managers (resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:44-47, resources/views/livewire/entity/dashboard.blade.php:18-22); no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The two tests covering removeMember()'s safety rules ('cannot remove the last manager of an entity' and 'cannot remove the owner; managers can remove members') were deleted and replaced by a test that only removes an employee, so the never-owner and never-last-manager removal requirements are no longer covered, contrary to the rule that tests must not be deleted.

selectedMembershipId and confirmingRemoval are server-context record/flag properties but are not marked #[Locked], against Livewire rule 2; the impact is bounded because every action re-resolves the membership through $this->entity->memberships().

confirmRemoval() and cancelRemoval() are public actions that never call $this->authorize(), violating the 'authorize every action' rule; they only toggle a boolean, so the practical impact is limited, but it is still an unguarded endpoint.

There is no tamper test that sets selectedMembershipId directly to a foreign membership before saveRole()/removeMember(), and no action-level unauthorized test for sendInvite()/cancelInvite() (only the mount-level forbidden test), which falls short of the per-action unauthorized + tamper requirement.

The subject uses __('You are invited to :entity') but no such key was added to lang/pt_BR.json, and the test asserts an English subject under pt_BR, so Brazilian Portuguese invite e-mails have a mixed-language subject despite the requirement that all strings be translation keys.

Re-inviting an address deletes any invite with accepted_at set, not just expired ones, so previously accepted invite history is silently destroyed even though the task only allows replacing an expired pending invite.

Invites whose entity was soft-deleted are neither filtered nor eager-loaded with trashed entities, so $invite->entity->name / ->slug dereferences null and breaks the switcher/onboarding list and accept redirect.

Accepting an invite creates the EntityMembership and updates accepted_at inline in the component instead of an app/Actions/* use-case class, which the conventions require for domain writes (the same applies to the invite insert in Members::sendInvite).

openMember() prefills memberRole with 'owner' for the owner's membership, but the select has no owner option, so the control shows no selection and saveRole() returns an 'in' validation error instead of the specified 403 immutability response.
invitedBy(), scopeExpired(), isPending() and the accepted() factory state are used only by tests or not at all, adding speculative surface beyond what the task needs.

review.summary: The change replaces instant member addition with an invite-only flow: an entity_invites model/migration/factory, a queued markdown invite mail, a PendingInvites accept/decline component on the switcher and onboarding, and a manager-only members page with member-detail and removal-confirmation modals, all documented and covered by Pest tests. It is broadly complete and well structured, but the two tests covering the removal guards (never the owner, never the last manager) were deleted without replacement and public IDs/flags are not #[Locked], so changes are needed before merging.
